observations.flags_3_components: All 49 components have trailing_field[:16] non-zero and trailing_field[16:] == 0x00*16.
observations.cross_version: Between V1.3 and V1.4, identical-hash components have completely different trailing_field[:16].
observations.conclusion: The 16-byte trailing field is not a deterministic hash or HMAC of public metadata or plaintext. Its properties are strictly consistent with a per-component cryptographic IV, nonce, or packaging-time salt.
